# Mixed-document evaluation goldens

**Purpose:** Specify the independent synthetic D23 corpus and its intentionally empty, degraded and unsupported cases.

`manifest.json` is the reviewed oracle, not a snapshot generated by the production parser. It declares exact text, native workbook lexical cells/styles/formulas/cache, expected outcomes and stage/code/status for expected rejections. D18–D21 independent fixture documentation supplies the PDF/DOCX/XLSX/OCR ground truth; production code is evaluated against that ground truth. Fixture hashes are retained in every measured report. No user documents, credentials or remote downloads are included.

| Cases | Independent intent |
|---|---|
| unicode / notes / rows | Exact TXT/Markdown/CSV bytes, combining marks, non-BMP Unicode, whitespace/CRLF, lexical markup and quoted CSV newline; no table inference |
| native-pdf | Existing PDF3-page golden: exact English/Unicode text plus native blank page |
| scan-native | Existing scanned PDF has two empty native projections; explicit OCR remains required |
| docx-read | Existing7 paragraphs, declared Heading1,3 styled runs, TableGrid3 rows, gridSpan2 merged final cell |
| xlsx-read | Existing2 sheets, literal/shared-string/boolean/style/merge metadata, formulas/attributes and explicit stale caches30/60 |
| ocr-clean / scan-ocr | Exact known English invoice transcription |
| ocr-blank / scan-blank | Empty recognized text with review required and absent score |
| ocr-degraded | Ground truth is `uncertain 7381`; existing blur is unreadable. CER/WER remain measured against this actual text; uncertainty detection is the case gate, not transcription success |
| vision-table | Explicit local CORE reads existing Vietnamese table: exact3 rows/6 cells, always-review/no numeric confidence. Narrative text is not assigned an invented ground truth |
| docx-rewrite / xlsx-rewrite | Fixed `Đã sửa` first-run edit / A2 numeric99.5; independent python-docx/openpyxl reopen, exact unchanged package members, reparse/chunk output with output hash and a separate synthetic file identity |
| nested-table | New python-docx-generated main-body nested table; actual parser exposes both tables, adapter must reject overlapping paragraph membership422 at adapt stage |
| large-row | Existing XLSX with256-byte chunk cap; atomic row exceeds cap,413 at chunk stage |
| invalid-pdf | New explicitly labeled malformed PDF bytes;415 at verify stage |

New plain fixtures contain their purpose in their content. The local `.gitattributes` preserves exact `unicode.txt` bytes across checkout and permits its intentional trailing tab/CRLF for this single fixture; other files retain normal whitespace checks. `nested.docx` was generated using dev-only python-docx; its body states its purpose and contains one outer and one nested table. It has no macros/external relationships. `invalid.pdf` is deliberately invalid and contains its purpose in a PDF comment. Binary fixtures are committed so dates/ZIP generation need not be reproduced during acceptance; do not regenerate them while scoring.

The evaluator independently checks source field interval coverage/no overlap, exact text slices, row JSON/structure, declared section mapping, cache/review propagation, private source-bound access metadata and the documented digest formula. Repeat checks apply to the same parsed content, not nondeterministic model transcription. Synthetic identity checks do not replace D22's real HTTP owner/namespace/lifecycle regression.

Run `uv run python -m scripts.document_pipeline_acceptance --include-vlm --output docs/evidence/d23-document-pipeline.json`. Without explicit `--include-vlm`, the required vision case is `not_run`, report incomplete and exit1. Report content includes only safe fixture/case names, hashes/versions, metrics/check flags, fixed error codes and timing/resource evidence. It excludes source/recognized text/images/tables and private exception messages. Gate failure and known transcription failure use separate lists; a green evaluation gate does not erase degraded OCR accuracy failure.
